name: Book Tavern Sign with Custom Shape Wooden Tag and LED Lamp
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:
    - Features a decorative Black Metal Sign Bracket with ornate scrollwork design, paired with a custom-printed Wooden Tag and an LED Lamp for a unique hanging display.
    -Metal bracket is crafted from durable metal with a classic fleur-de-lis cutout accent on the mounting plate.
    -Wooden tag is 3mm thick with 1-sided UV printing on the front and a natural wood finish on the back.
    - LED lamp is made of plastic material, providing soft ambient light for a cozy decorative effect.
    Available in 3 lamp options:
      +) Ghost (4.8 x 5.73 cm ~ 1.89 x 2.26 in)
      +)  Lantern (5.03 x 5.93 cm ~ 1.98 x 2.33 in)
      +) Pumpkin (7.97 x 5.73 cm ~ 3.14 x 2.26 in)
    Includes screws and metal hanging chain for easy assembly.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall: 10.04 x 9.25 in ~ 25.5 x 23.5 cm
      +) Mounting plate: 4.53 x 9.25 in ~ 11.5 x 23.5 cm
      +) Arm length: 5.51 in ~ 14 cm
    - Wooden Tag: 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed

 

  • Printing Technology:
    -Features high-quality UV printing on the wooden tag for clear, vibrant, and detailed personalized artwork.
    -Produced using precision laser cutting for smooth edges and clean custom silhouette shapes on the wooden tag.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    -Designed as a tabletop decorative sign for bookshelves, desks, reading nooks, hobby corners, and themed spaces.
    -Suitable for personalization with names, themed artwork, quotes, fantasy designs, and custom illustrations.
    -The wooden tag and LED lamp hang from the metal bracket via metal chains, creating an eye-catching layered display.
    -Provides soft ambient light from the LED lamp for a cozy atmosphere.
    -Easy to use - no additional tools needed for assembly.
    -Functional and decorative - perfect for any space including bedrooms, living rooms, offices, and gift shops.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    -A meaningful personalized gift for book lovers, fantasy fans, hobbyists, friends, and family members.
    -Perfect for birthdays, housewarming, holidays, themed room décor, and special occasions.
    -Great for creating custom displays with personalized artwork and themed decorative details.
    -Ideal as a unique keepsake that combines the warmth of natural wood, the elegance of ornate metalwork, and the charm of a decorative LED lamp.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 8 – 15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Book Tavern Sign with Custom Shape Wooden Tag and LED Lamp

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow  0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
